sourcesContent:
app TypedDurableAdmission
Given
 Entry { label:text, count:int=1, stamp:datetime server=now }
 policy Entry read=public
When
 crud Entry by=owner fields=label,count
 ## Owner is the live team membership role. A later guard must roll back the staged update.
 scenario change(entry:Entry,delta:int,accept:bool) -> int by=owner
  do
   require entry.stamp==entry.created
   set entry {count=entry.count+delta}
   require accept
   return entry.count
Then
